description: Purchased trading merchandise goods (electronic items) on credit from vendor Bengal Electricals ₹1,20,000
narration: Being trading goods purchased for resale on credit as per Tax Invoice #BE-801
explanation: Goods bought for RESALE are debited to Purchases Account (Nominal Expense A/c Dr ₹1,20,000), not an asset account.

description: Purchased office wooden desks, executive chairs, and display racks for shop setup on credit from Godrej Furniture Ltd ₹85,000
narration: Being office furniture purchased for shop setup on credit as per Tax Invoice #GF-104
explanation: Capital asset purchased for LONG-TERM USE (not resale) MUST be debited directly to Furniture & Fixtures Asset A/c (NOT Purchases A/c).

description: Purchased HP Desktop Computer & LaserJet printer for billing counter paid by SBI Bank cheque ₹48,000
narration: Being billing computer and printer purchased for office use via bank cheque
explanation: Office equipment acquired for business operations is debited to Computer Equipment Asset A/c ₹48,000, crediting Bank Asset A/c.

description: Sold trading merchandise goods for cash to retail customers ₹65,000
narration: Being cash sales executed as per Cash Memo #105
explanation: Sale of routine trading inventory is credited to Sales Revenue Account (Nominal Revenue A/c Cr ₹65,000).

description: Sold trading merchandise goods on credit to customer Sharma Traders ₹90,000
narration: Being trading goods sold on credit as per Sales Invoice #SI-201
explanation: Credit sale of inventory creates Sundry Debtor Asset (Debit Sharma Traders ₹90,000) and increases Sales Revenue (Credit Sales A/c ₹90,000).

description: Sold old surplus office wooden table (book value ₹12,000) for cash ₹12,000
narration: Being old office furniture sold at book value for cash
explanation: Sale of a fixed asset is credited directly to the Asset Account (Furniture A/c Cr ₹12,000), NEVER credited to Sales A/c!

description: Sold old motor delivery van (book value ₹1,20,000) for cash ₹1,40,000, making a profit of ₹20,000

creditLines.account: Profit on Sale of Fixed Asset Account

narration: Being old delivery van sold for cash at a profit of ₹20,000
explanation: Compound Asset Sale: Asset Account is credited with book value (₹1,20,000), cash debited (₹1,40,000), and capital gain credited to Profit on Sale of Asset A/c (₹20,000).

description: Sold damaged office desktop computer (book value ₹25,000) for scrap cash ₹18,000, incurring a loss of ₹7,000

debitLines.account: Loss on Sale of Fixed Asset Account

narration: Being damaged computer sold for cash at a loss of ₹7,000
explanation: Compound Asset Sale at Loss: Asset Account is credited with full book value (₹25,000), Cash debited (₹18,000), and loss debited to Loss on Sale of Asset A/c (₹7,000).

description: Purchased commercial delivery motor van on credit from Auto Motors Ltd ₹3,50,000
narration: Being delivery van purchased for business operations on credit
explanation: Fixed asset purchase must be debited to Motor Vehicle Asset A/c (NOT Purchases A/c) as it is not intended for resale.

description: Sold old surplus lathe machine (book value ₹80,000) for cash ₹80,000 at book value
narration: Being old machinery sold for cash at book value
explanation: Sale of plant machinery credits Plant & Machinery Asset A/c ₹80,000, crediting Cash Asset A/c.
